resources.string: Speech recognition needs a Whisper model. Download one on the Models tab.
No speech was found in the recording.
The file is long: only its first %1$d minutes were recognized.
There is nothing to speak with yet: the device has no speech service, and no speech model is installed. Download one on the Models tab.
Only the device\'s own voices are available. Neural voices can be downloaded on the Models tab.
This voice speaks at its own pace
Copying a voice needs the Chatterbox Multilingual model. Download it on the Models tab.
Record about %1$d seconds of clear speech with no music or noise, or pick a recording. The new voice will then be offered in the voice list and can speak any of the model\'s languages.
Copy only your own voice or the voice of someone who agreed to it.
Hello! This is how my voice sounds.
A Whisper model as a ggml .bin file, or a .zip archive with the files of a speech model.
The smallest and fastest. Fine for clear English, error-prone in Russian.
Fast and light; handles clear Russian and English speech. A good first choice.
Noticeably more accurate in Russian, several times slower than Base.
The most accurate here, for long or noisy recordings. Slow on a phone.
Fast neural voices, 5 female and 5 male, in 31 languages including Russian and English. Speed can be adjusted. OpenRAIL-M licence.
Speaks in a voice copied from a short recording, in 20 languages including Russian and English. Much slower than Supertonic and heavy on memory.
The microphone is not allowed. Grant the permission in the app settings.
The microphone could not be opened. Another app may be using it.
No speech recognition model is installed.
There is no voice to speak with: install a speech model.
No model that can copy voices is installed.
The sample is too short: at least 3 seconds of speech are needed.
